title: Scheme I - Product Certification Scheme (ISI Mark)
description: Flagship BIS certification scheme requiring factory quality management in-house testing lab and physical audit.
keywords: isi mark; scheme 1; factory audit; domestic licence; manakonline; testing lab
testing_requirements: Verification of manufacturing machinery in-house testing lab calibration and witness sample testing

title: Scheme II - Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS)
description: Registration based on self-declaration of conformity and third-party accredited lab testing without pre-grant factory visit.
keywords: crs; compulsory registration; meity; it products; mobile; laptop; test report
testing_requirements: Product testing in BIS-recognized laboratory in India against relevant safety requirements

title: Foreign Manufacturers Certification Scheme (FMCS)
product: Overseas Manufactured Goods Exported to India
description: Enables foreign manufacturing facilities to apply for and use the ISI Mark on goods destined for India.
keywords: fmcs; overseas manufacturers; foreign licence; air; authorized representative
testing_requirements: Foreign factory physical inspection by BIS technical auditor and independent test verification in India

title: Scheme IV - Certificate of Conformity (CoC)
description: Designed for specific manufactured batches without continuous mass production factory licensing requirements.
keywords: certificate of conformity; coc; lot validation; batch testing; scheme 4
testing_requirements: Independent lot sampling and testing against specified clauses of the standard

title: Management Systems Certification Scheme (MSCS)
description: Certification of management systems in organizations across ISO 9001 ISO 14001 ISO 45001 and ISO 22000.
keywords: mscs; iso 9001; iso 14001; quality management; environmental system; audit
testing_requirements: Stage 1 documentation adequacy audit and Stage 2 comprehensive on-site certification audit
